result.title: Rational Alignments of Superintelligences via Debates
result.summary: Artificial superintelligences (ASI) is artificial intelligences with greater capability. However, as human principal has to use it, we have to ensure that the agent will perform in the interest of the human. We investigate the framework of ASI-assisted question answering where ASI agents know the correct answer but the human does not. We provide some example of mechanism for rational alignment, where the agent utility is unchanged, but the interaction between the agent and the human principal is controlled to be in a certain fashion. We show specifically that a debate framework where the agents can further reason and behave in a subgame perfect equilibrium manner will lead to a more predictable result, and in some case will be favorable.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在「ASI 辅助问答」设定下研究理性对齐机制：不改变代理效用，而通过约束代理与人类委托方的交互方式来保证行为符合人类利益，并论证辩论框架中代理以子博弈完美均衡方式推理时结果更可预测、有时更有利。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属博弈论对齐理论，不涉及视觉状态、证据使用或 latent 生成，与主线无直接联系；但其关于辩论均衡下结果可预测性的分析，或可作为多智能体/辩论式验证与推理停止决策的可控性参照，需核查此类概念类比是否具有实际借鉴价值。
